MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails, wood screws and drywall anchors suggest fastening wood or mounting things; nuts, epoxy and magnets serve different purposes even though they can also hold things together.",
    "Calipers, casters and pressure gauges require specific tasks that my recent purchases do not establish, so I would not choose them just because they are workshop supplies.",
    "Medicine cups do not indicate that I own a TENS unit, and my fastening purchases do not suggest a need for wiring connectors or grommets.",
    "Outdoor tape shares the weather resistance of my deck screws, but it does not perform the fastening job I currently need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat general repair and workshop supplies as interchangeable with the particular fasteners I have been choosing.",
    "Shared details such as mounting screws, outdoor durability or a medical use seem to carry more weight than whether the item serves the same practical need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several closely spaced purchases of nails and wood screws provide a stronger clue to my current needs than an isolated purchase of medicine cups.",
    "Fastener type, dimensions, material compatibility and intended use matter to me; simply being useful for repairs is too broad a connection.",
    "My vacuum bag purchase names specific compatible vacuum types, which suggests a replacement need rather than a general interest in unrelated maintenance supplies."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions picked up a broad repair theme but missed the specific fastening and replacement needs behind my purchases, leaving me with no item I would choose now."
}
